journey.title: Answer what a supervisor is waiting on
journey.purpose: From the Now titles to the item itself, opened in place, answered with the recommended option already shown, the exact entry from the API's dry run confirmed before anything is written, and the answer read back once the supervisor has seen it.

steps.intent: See the count and the first titles of what needs the operator.
Land on that item, scrolled to and opened; read where it came from, its delivery state and the recommended answer.
Confirm the exact entry and where it is appended before it is written.
See the answer and whether the supervisor has seen it; a global item without a commission instead says where it is answered.
